drill.jaymoskingdoms.under_way.0: Keep at it, %s. The drill is not done.
drill.jaymoskingdoms.under_way.2: Don't look at me, %s. Finish what we began.
drill.jaymoskingdoms.elsewhere.0: One drill at a time, %s. See the other through first.
drill.jaymoskingdoms.busy.0: I'm in the middle of a drill, %s. Wait your turn.
drill.jaymoskingdoms.busy.1: Not now, %s. I have someone in hand.
drill.jaymoskingdoms.busy.2: Give me a moment, %s. Someone's ahead of you.
drill.jaymoskingdoms.tomorrow.0: That's enough for today, %s. Come back tomorrow.
drill.jaymoskingdoms.tomorrow.1: You've had your drill today, %s. Rest.
drill.jaymoskingdoms.not_now.0: Not like this, %s. Get your strength back first.
drill.jaymoskingdoms.not_now.1: You're in no state, %s. Mend and come back.
drill.jaymoskingdoms.not_now.2: Rest first, %s. A drill is no place to fall.
drill.jaymoskingdoms.shield.0: Bring a shield, %s, and I'll drill you in the guard.
drill.jaymoskingdoms.shield.1: No shield, no parries, %s. Come back with one.
drill.jaymoskingdoms.shield.2: Where's your shield, %s? Fetch one and ask again.
drill.jaymoskingdoms.no_room.0: There's no room to drill here, %s. Find open ground.
drill.jaymoskingdoms.no_room.1: Too cramped, %s. Try again in the open.
drill.jaymoskingdoms.no_room.2: Not here, %s. I need space to work.
drill.jaymoskingdoms.called_off.0: Drill's off, %s. Come back when you mean it.
drill.jaymoskingdoms.called_off.1: We're done here, %s. The drill is called off.
drill.jaymoskingdoms.gate.start.0: Hold the gate, %s! Here they come!
drill.jaymoskingdoms.gate.start.1: Steady, %s. Cut them down as they come.
drill.jaymoskingdoms.gate.start.2: Back to the gate, %s. Don't give an inch!
drill.jaymoskingdoms.gate.done.2: Not a one got past, %s. Good.
drill.jaymoskingdoms.gate.lost.0: Too slow, %s. The gate would have fallen.
drill.jaymoskingdoms.gate.lost.1: They'd have taken the gate, %s. Again another day.
drill.jaymoskingdoms.gate.lost.2: You didn't hold, %s. Learn from it.
drill.jaymoskingdoms.parries.start.0: Shield up, %s. Turn ten of my blows.
drill.jaymoskingdoms.parries.start.1: Ten parries, %s. Keep your guard high.
drill.jaymoskingdoms.parries.start.2: Here I come, %s. Watch my arm, not my face.
drill.jaymoskingdoms.parries.done.1: Good guard, %s. Remember how it felt.
drill.jaymoskingdoms.parries.done.2: You read me well, %s. That'll do.
drill.jaymoskingdoms.parries.lost.1: Too few turned, %s. Practice, then come again.
drill.jaymoskingdoms.parries.lost.2: Keep that shield up, %s. We'll try another day.
drill.jaymoskingdoms.spar.start.1: Spar with me, %s. No killing, only the lesson.
drill.jaymoskingdoms.spar.start.2: Come at me, %s. We stop at the first fall.
drill.jaymoskingdoms.spar.done.0: You put me down, %s. Well struck.
drill.jaymoskingdoms.spar.done.1: First fall to you, %s. I yield.
drill.jaymoskingdoms.spar.lost.0: First fall to me, %s. Hold your guard higher.
drill.jaymoskingdoms.spar.lost.1: You fell first, %s. Come again tomorrow.
drill.jaymoskingdoms.spar.lost.2: That's the fall, %s. You'll learn from it.
drill.jaymoskingdoms.spar.draw.0: Neither of us fell, %s. We'll call it even.
drill.jaymoskingdoms.spar.draw.1: A draw, %s. Next time, finish it.
